args.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE square transparent PNG character asset for a card game. Image 1 is the reference for this ADULT WOMAN's identity, face, hairstyle, GREEN eyes, natural physique and polished fine anime linework with smooth cel shading and gentle gradients. Preserve her glossy BLACK neck-to-shoulder-length bob, side part, long sweeping side forelocks, softly curved tips, both visible green eyes with long lashes, refined brows, small nose and chin, pale warm skin and gentle cheek blush. OUTFIT CHANGE explicitly requested: REMOVE the entire WHITE JACKET / outer shirt. She wears ONLY the reference's opaque plain BLACK SLEEVELESS HIGH-NECK ribbed top and plain BLACK high-waisted skirt. No jacket, blazer, coat, sleeves or draped fabric on arms, no added outfit layers. Preserve the reference gold delicate geometric drop earrings and thin gold necklace with one small oval pendant; no new jewelry, finger rings, wristwatch, bag, glasses or other accessories. Keep her natural adult proportions without new body emphasis. Use an upright natural game-character pose instead of copying the leaning-forward pose. True transparent background, no classroom, scenery, furniture, text, logos, cards, props, hearts, sparkles, borders or cast shadow. Complete entire hair crown, hair sides, both elbows and all hands/fingertips INSIDE the square with generous clear transparent top and side margins. Match the reference face, hair, black top/skirt and jewelry consistently across all six assets. Head-and-shoulders close portrait, nearly front facing. Both GREEN eyes softly narrowed in a perceptive, knowing look, a small poised closed-mouth smile as if she has understood her opponent's strategy. Keep the face large for a 256px icon. Complete highest hair tip and rounded crown with 10 percent transparent margin above. Show the high black collar and oval pendant; no hands. Output square 1024x1024.
